HEIF item layer (clean-room): meta-box parse per ISO/IEC 23008-12. Covers ftyp brands, pitm, iloc (v0/v1/v2), iinf/infe (v2/v3), iprp (ipco raw properties + ipma v0/v1 associations), iref, idat location. Only boxes real writers emit are interpreted; anything else is skipped.

Imports

isobmff, ../../error

Types

HeifItem = object
  id*: uint32
  typ*: string
  hidden*: bool
  contentType*: string       ## for 'mime' (e.g. application/rdf+xml)
  itemName*: string
  itemUri*: string           ## for 'uri ' items
HeifMeta = object
  majorBrand*: string
  compatBrands*: seq[string]
  items*: seq[HeifItem]
  primaryId*: uint32
  hasPrimary*: bool
  extents*: seq[tuple[id: uint32, runs: seq[ItemExtent]]]
  props*: seq[tuple[id: uint32, props: seq[RawProperty]]]
  refs*: seq[HeifRef]
  idatOff*: int
  idatLen*: int
  hasIdat*: bool
HeifRef = object
  fromId*: uint32
  refType*: string
  toIds*: seq[uint32]
ItemExtent = object
  kind*: int                 ## 0=file, 1=idat, 2=item
  offset*: int
  length*: int               ## -1 = implied (to end of file/source)
  srcIndex*: int             ## 1-based extent_index for kind==2, else 0
One data run. For file/idat the offset is absolute (file) or idat-relative (base+eoff); for item references it is an offset inside the referenced source item's bytes. 
RawProperty = object
  kind*: string
  payload*: seq[uint8]
  essential*: bool
